name: finolabs-vibecode
description: Engineering practice for AI coding agents: routing, delegation, review and security gates, verification, versioning, agent scans and mode settings.
suggestedPrompts: Route this change through the coding router and tell me the depth you chose.
Use fnl-delegate to coordinate this spec with one session per task.
Prepare the version bump and changelog for the next release.
Use fnl-scan-agents to refresh my local agent inventory, then fnl-set-mode to show effective settings.
